verdicts.reason: Both shrink the can to a small centred object and leave the bottom ~35% as dead space, so the product hero is lost. In A the logo is tiny and centred over left-aligned text that sits cramped at a ~25px left margin. B has a better margin, but its logo floats at an arbitrary right-of-centre spot that lines up with neither the text edge nor the can's axis. A is slightly more coherent because its logo and can share a centre axis.
